events.title: How Meta-progression Fixed our Game's Biggest Problem
events.summary: Randomness in games is great, right? Well, not exactly.The GoodBy randomising different elements of our game, we greatly increased replay value, as each run is different, and the player has to adapt to whatever the game throws at them. They are unable to use their same winning strategy over and over again and instead have to come up with ideas on the fly.
